bitrix24_updated_contact_trigger.description: Runs each time a contact in the Bitrix24 CRM is changed or created. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The contact's id, for Update contact.

bitrix24_updated_deal_trigger.description: Runs each time a deal in Bitrix24 is changed or created, in one pipeline or all of them. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.category_id: The pipeline's id (0 is the main one).
output.close_date: When it is expected to close.
output.id: The deal's id, for Get deal or Update deal.
output.moved_at: When it last moved to another stage.
output.stage_id: The stage's code, such as C1:NEW.
output.title: The deal's title.

parameters.description: Only deals in this pipeline. Leave empty for every pipeline.
parameters.name: category_id

bitrix24_updated_lead_trigger.description: Runs each time a lead in the Bitrix24 CRM is changed or created. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The lead's id, for Get lead or Update lead.
output.source_id: Where it came from, such as WEB.
output.status_id: The lead's status code, such as NEW.
output.title: The lead's title.

bitrix24_updated_task_trigger.description: Runs each time a Bitrix24 task you can see is changed or created, for one assignee or everyone. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.closed_at: When it was completed, if it was.
output.id: The task's id, for Get task or Update task.
output.status: Its status: 2 waiting, 3 in progress, 4 waiting for review, 5 completed, 6 deferred.
output.title: The task's title.

parameters.description: Only tasks assigned to this person. Leave empty for everyone's.
parameters.name: responsible_id
